answer: A new identity starts on a ledge, a probation tier with zero payout weight, and leaves it only through jury duty. Each epoch it gets 6 blind answers no other identity sees, and every score it gives is a signal later checked against the panel median. Scores within one point extend its vine, a hash chain of matched grades; 30 links lift it off the ledge, and a missed epoch resets the chain. Each fake pays 6 real judgments per epoch, about 9,000 tokens, even if never caught, so 500 fakes owe 3,000 grades an epoch. Random scores miss the median.
